summary: Independent review comparison: REJECTED (approve: false). Evaluation compared claimed acceptance areas against actual browser QA evidence. Task 74843670617f provided only narrative prose in its summary rather than verifiable step-by-step observed actions and programmatic assertions in a structured browser_qa_evidence.steps record. Additionally, intermediate screenshots cited in the prose (009.png for boundary-touch contact, 017.png for strict interval overlap warning and edit mode, 024.png for batch copy preview, and 029.png for weekly view aggregation) are absent from disk in .web-dev/feedback/qa-review (where only 001.png and 037.png exist). Following the strict directive not to infer a pass from QA prose and to reject when required scenarios lack observed actions and assertions, approval is denied and targeted QA is delegated to execute concrete browser interactions, assertions, and artifact retention across all acceptance areas on http://127.0.0.1:9002/.
